sn47.38:1.1: Cattāro me bhikkhave satipaṭṭhānā || katame cattāro || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || tassa kāye kāyānupassino viharato kāyo pariññāto hoti || kāyassa pariññātattā amataṃ sacchikataṃ hoti
sn47.38:4.1: Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ. || tassa dhammesu dhammānupassino viharato dhammā pariññātā honti || dhammānam pariññātattā amataṃ sacchikatam hotī ti || ||
